description: Declarative job model (AD-10, O8 hybrid ruling; driver-contract §4). A job is data; the bound substrate executes it (v1 default: harness-native primitives). Generic job types ship with the plugin as jobs/<type-id>.json; per-project instances are .tk-studio/jobs/<job-id>.json files named by the tracked config's jobs[] list of scalar ids — the config surface stays inside the miniyaml subset, never inline job mappings. lib/job.py is the one validator (no other surface parses definitions); validation rejects any definition missing budget guards or stop conditions — a job never runs away. Run state lives in resumable run workspaces ~/.tk-studio/projects/<key>/runs/<run-id>/run.json (working data, never on any VCS — AD-3). The run state enum matches the driver-contract §4 status verb exactly.

id.note: stable job identity; must equal the definition file's stem

type.note: id of a shipped generic job type this instance extends: instance fields override the type's, target keys overlay the type's target, payload shallow-merges with instance keys winning

target.note: what the job executes; at least one of skill|core

skill.note: a contract surface by name (driver-contract §2); payload maps 1:1 onto its flags

core.note: plugin-root-relative deterministic-core argv (same shape as conformance drives) for pure-data jobs; never an absolute path

payload.note: arguments for the target; defaults to {}

at.note: one-shot only: execute at this time instead of immediately

cadence.required: for trigger cron|loop; forbidden for one-shot

mode.note: cron is inherently fixed — self-paced is valid only for loop

interval_seconds.required: when trigger is loop and mode is fixed

hint_seconds.note: self-paced pacing hint; the substrate decides (> 0)

durable.note: durable-recurring requirement: local harness schedules are session-scoped, so a session-scoped binding MUST surface this constraint (cloud routine or external harness needed) instead of silently losing the schedule (ST-6.2)

guards.note: budget guards — at least one required, values > 0; a guard hit ends the run partial with the guard named in reason (§4)

stop.note: stop conditions — at least one required; ends scheduling, distinct from per-run budget guards

max_runs.note: integer > 0: stop scheduling after this many runs

on_status.note: stop scheduling after a run ends in one of these states

model.note: Claude model override the wrapper passes down (driver-contract §5 runtime override); absent = the target resource's customize.toml default resolves (AD-14)

effort.note: reasoning-effort override, same precedence as model

run_id.note: <job-id>-<UTC compact timestamp>, suffixed on collision; equals the workspace directory name

project.note: project key: explicit project_id from tracked config, else the root basename — the same identity as the registry (AD-20)

state.note: §4 status-verb states; queued|running are resumable, the rest are terminal and immutable

reason.note: required by §4 semantics when state is partial|blocked|cancelled — names the guard, stop condition, or gap

status_block.note: the terminal §3 JSON status block of the run

job.note: resolved definition snapshot at submit time — resumability means a fresh process continues from the workspace alone, never re-reading project config mid-run

checkpoint.note: free-form resumable progress state, owned by the executing wrapper

counters.note: budget accounting toward guards: tokens, turns, wall_clock_seconds
